# Dentocare Task Outline & Design Notes

## Source Reference

- **ColorLib Template**: Toothcare (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/toothcare/`)
- **Live Preview**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/toothcare/`
- **Assigned Name**: `dentocare` (`apps/dentocare`)

## Section Structure & Order

1. **Top Bar / Navbar**: Contact info bar + fixed navigation menu with smooth scroll links and booking action.
2. **Hero Carousel / Banner**: Large medical/dental background with bold headline and CTA buttons.
3. **Appointment Form Section**: Interactive booking form with doctor dropdown selection and contact inputs.
4. **Services Grid**: Card layout showcasing dental care specialties with icons.
5. **Intro Banner / Stats**: High-contrast stats counter banner (patients, procedures, support).
6. **Dentists Section**: Professional team grid with headshots, credentials, and social icons.
7. **Call To Action Banner**: Full-width prompt for immediate appointment scheduling.
8. **Testimonials / Treatment Results**: Carousel or card layout showing patient success stories.
9. **Blog / Recent Posts**: Dental health tips and articles grid.
10. **Pricing & Packages**: Transparent pricing tiers.
11. **Footer**: Comprehensive column layout with links, contact details, and required Component Dock branding (`https://www.componentdock.com/`).

## Design Tokens & Styling Notes

- **Colors**: Cyan (`#00bcd4`), Dark Neutral (`#212529`), Light Gray (`#f8f9fa`).
- **Typography**: Clean sans-serif (`Roboto`).
- **Icons**: Lucide React icons matching dental and contact themes.
